target_vertical: Multi-channel e-commerce retailer / DTC brand (Shopify-heavy installed base; also light manufacturing and dropshipping)
pricing_model: Tiered by product module (Shipping, Inventory, Dropshipping) with per-month plans; bundled pricing on request
starting_price_usd: $0/month (Shipping free tier); Inventory starts ~$349/month; Dropshipping ~$299/month (2026 pricing)
free_trial_or_freemium: 15-day free trial; Shipping module has a free tier
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional: orders pulled from Shopify, inventory and fulfillment/tracking pushed back to Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory levels, orders, customers, fulfillments/tracking; Shopify Locations mapped to Ordoro warehouses
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — supports multiple Shopify and Shopify Plus stores in one Ordoro account
shopify_pos_support: Yes — Ordoro identifies the Shopify POS an order was placed on and assigns it to the corresponding brick-and-mortar warehouse
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Variants imported as SKUs; mapped 1:1 with Ordoro products; supports linking inventory across like SKUs from the same channel
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Real-time via Shopify webhooks ("Instasync") for order import
shopify_known_limitations: Inventory write-back depends on correct Locations mapping; limited handling of Shopify Markets / B2B catalogs not publicly documented; some users report sync delays during high-volume periods [uncertain on specifics]
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync-only — imports existing Etsy listings; can activate/deactivate listings based on stock level, but does not create new listings from Ordoro
etsy_inventory_sync: Inventory sync per variation SKU; deactivates listings when stock reaches zero; requires "Quantities vary" option on Etsy variations
etsy_order_import: Automatic import of paid + unfulfilled orders on a regular schedule
etsy_known_limitations: Cannot create new Etsy listings; common writeback errors related to variation configuration; some Etsy shipping addresses fail to import; no documented support for personalization fields or digital products
amazon_marketplaces: Amazon US, CA, UK Seller Central (Professional accounts only; Individual accounts not supported)
amazon_seller_types: FBA and FBM (Seller-Fulfilled). Vendor Central not supported [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings, inventory, orders (Unshipped, PartiallyShipped, InvoiceUnconfirmed), shipments/tracking, FBA stock levels; supports Multi-Channel Fulfillment routing (e.g., Shopify → FBA)
amazon_listing_creation: Sync existing listings only; listing creation from Ordoro not a primary documented feature [uncertain]
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: FBA inbound shipment workflow supported; Multi-Channel Fulfillment routing from non-Amazon channels to FBA is supported [uncertain on detailed flow]
amazon_settlement_report_handling: [uncertain] — Ordoro is primarily order/inventory/shipping focused; settlement-report-to-accounting reconciliation is not a documented core feature
amazon_multi_account_support: Multiple Amazon seller accounts supported as separate sales channels [uncertain on tenant-level limits]
amazon_known_limitations: US, CA, UK marketplaces only (no EU, AU, JP, MX, IN per public docs); Individual Seller accounts not supported; no in-app repricer
xero_supported: None (no native Xero integration documented; only third-party data-warehouse style connectors like SyncHub)
xero_app_store_certified: Not listed on Xero App Store
xero_known_limitations: No native Xero integration; users typically use third-party connectors or a reporting layer (e.g., SyncHub)
qb_online_supported: Yes — native QuickBooks Online integration (launched Feb 2023)
qb_desktop_supported: No — does not integrate with QuickBooks Desktop directly (third-party connectors like Connex / Cloud Cart Connector exist)
qb_app_certified: Listed on QuickBooks Online (Intuit App Store) [uncertain on certification badge]
qb_synced_entities: Customers, products/inventory, sales receipts (default for shipped orders), invoices (for orders tagged "Invoice"), purchase orders
qb_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order (each shipped order posts as a Sales Receipt by default, or Invoice if tagged); no summary-journal mode documented
qb_cogs_journal_method: [uncertain] — Ordoro syncs orders/inventory/POs but COGS journaling method is not clearly documented
qb_known_limitations: Only shipped orders sync; autosync not available (manual/triggered sync); QuickBooks integration limited to Premium plan and above; no QuickBooks Desktop support
other_ecom_channels: BigCommerce, WooCommerce, eBay, Walmart, Magento, Volusion, Ecwid, TikTok Shop, Square, Reverb, Stripe (and others via API)
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — Kitting (Bundling) decrements component SKUs when a kit ships; supports nested kits and BOMs (BOM treated as already-manufactured finished good)
other_accounting_integrations: QuickBooks Online (native). No native Xero, Sage, Zoho Books, MYOB, FreshBooks, NetSuite, or Wave integration documented
bom_support: Yes — BOM feature for finished goods (in higher-tier plans)
multi_level_bom: [uncertain] — multi-level/nested BOM support not explicitly documented
production_orders: Yes — Manufacturing Orders (MOs) available in the top-tier plan, alongside BOMs and POs
serial_tracking: Yes — serial number capture at shipping for warranty/returns
bin_location_support: Yes — aisle/bin location per product, per warehouse (manually edited or bulk via data import)
multi_warehouse: Yes — multiple warehouses with independent inventory tracking
barcoding: Yes — barcode scanning for pick/pack workflows and barcode label printing
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, supplier management, partial receipts, supplier-SKU mapping
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records, dropshipper performance tracking, routing rules per product/supplier
landed_cost_support: [uncertain] — not clearly documented as a first-class feature
ai_demand_forecasting: No — no native AI/ML demand forecasting feature documented
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Reorder point / low-stock alerts and POs exist; AI-generated PO drafts not documented
public_api: Yes — REST API with Basic HTTP Authentication; API keys generated in Settings; available on Premium plan and above; developer portal at docs.ordoro.com and forums.ordoro.com
webhook_event_coverage: Webhooks management API exposed; covers order/shipment events [uncertain on full event list]
integration_architecture: Native (in-house built integrations for each major channel); supplemented by REST API and 3PL Central / Extensiv connector
zapier_make_support: No native Zapier integration; community Make.com connector exists (third-party)
mobile_app: Web-based / mobile-responsive scanning interface; no dedicated published native iOS/Android Ordoro app documented (uses phone camera via web for scanning)
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Barcode scanning via mobile browser / camera and via dedicated handheld scanners; no standalone native scanner app advertised
rate_limit_handling_documented: [uncertain] — public docs cover API authentication and endpoints; specific rate-limit handling for Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO not prominently documented
sync_frequency: Shopify: real-time via webhooks (Instasync). Amazon FBA: daily order imports. QuickBooks Online: manual/triggered (no autosync). Etsy: scheduled/automatic. Other channels: near real-time or scheduled depending on channel
shipping_carrier_integrations: USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL Express, DHL eCommerce, Canada Post, Australia Post, and additional regional carriers; discounted USPS Commercial Plus rates included; UPS Ready vendor with discounted UPS rates
shipping_label_buying: Yes — core feature; in-app label purchase across all integrated carriers with deeply discounted USPS and UPS rates
three_pl_integrations: Extensiv (formerly 3PL Central) via standard API integration on Enterprise plans; partnership with ShipBob for merchants needing distributed fulfillment
edi_support: Dropship orders can be sent to suppliers via CSV, EDI, or API; full retail-EDI compliance not a primary documented feature
g2_rating: [uncertain] — generally rated highly (~4.7/5) with positive reviews
capterra_rating: [uncertain] — generally rated highly with positive reviews
notable_customers: [uncertain] — Ordoro markets to SMB e-commerce merchants; case studies on site cover various Shopify/Amazon sellers
last_major_release: QuickBooks Online native integration launched Feb 2023; ongoing platform iteration; specific 2025/2026 major release [uncertain]
owner_parent_company: Independent — Ordoro, Inc. (privately held; not acquired)
last_funding_event: Seed round of $1.5M in Oct 2015 led by E-Merge; total ~$5.15M raised across rounds (investors include Texas Venture Labs, 500 Global / 500 Startups, Central Texas Angel Network); no recent funding events documented
public_status_page_uptime: https://ordoro.statuspage.io/ — public status page with 90-day uptime history; specific uptime percentage [uncertain]
